decisions.rationale: Initial exploration across primary sites s1 and s4 to identify strong baseline effects and uncover major objective trade-offs.
Evaluate combinations of s1=D/B with s4=E/C to see if we can achieve lower f1 while preserving low f2, testing key branch interactions.
s4=E strongly optimizes f2, while s1=D or s1=B improves f1. Testing variants of s4=E with s1=D/B and alternate (s2, s3) combinations targets the promising lower-f2 trade-off region.
Test s4=D across promising s1/s2/s3 contexts; s4=D previously achieved lowest f1 (config 5), and s1=B or E with s3=B may lower f1 further while checking f2 trade-offs.
Pairing s1=C with s4=B or s4=C explores favorable intermediate trade-offs between low f1 and low f2, leveraging s1=C's balanced performance.
Test s4=C with s2=A, s3=B combinations to find better trade-offs in mid-f1/f2 regions, and explore s4=A or s5/s6 variations on low f1 leaders.
Evaluation 28 achieved an extremely low f1 (4735) with s6=B on s4=D, s5=B. Testing s1=B and s1=E with s2=A, s3=B, s4=D, s5=B, s6=B could improve f2 while maintaining ultra-low f1.
Testing s4=B with s5=B, s6=B across different s1 roots to identify lower f1 while maintaining lower f2, particularly exploring s1=D and s1=E alongside s4=C with s6=B variations.
Explore diverse main label values at root sites s1 and s4 to identify strong baseline impacts on both cost metrics.
Combine label B on s1 with low f2 choices on s4 (like D or A) to balance the ultra-low f1 of B with lower f2.
Combine s1=B (enables ultra-low f1) with intermediate s4 values, and test s1=B with s2=B, s3=A combined with s4=B to find balanced trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
s1=B with s2=A, s3=B achieves ultralow f1, while s5=B, s6=B provides low f2. Testing combinations of s1=B, s2=A, s3=A and varying s4 to bridge the trade-off.
Combine low-f1 features (s1=B, s2=A, s3=B) with intermediate s5/s6 choices, and test s1=E/C with s4 combinations to uncover trade-offs between f1 ~5k and f2 ~1.8k.
Explore combinations around s1=E and s1=A with high-performing s4 choices. Combining s1=E with s4=B balances f1/f2, while testing s1=C with s2=A, s3=B could yield extremely low f1.
Combine top-performing low-f1 features (s1=C, s2=A, s3=B, s4=C) with varied s5/s6 configurations, and test s1=E with s4=C to exploit low f2 while maintaining low f1.
Evaluating s1=E across promising configurations (e.g. s4=A or s5=A/s6=B variations) to exploit its strong low-f2 profile and discover dominating intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
Explore varied primary categorical settings for s1 and s4 to identify strong baseline choices across the design space early.
Combine s1=A (which gave ultra-low f1 in config 2) with s4=E/D (which yielded low f2 in configs 1 and 5) to explore optimal trade-offs between f1 and f2.
s1=A with s2=A,s3=B achieves very low f1, while s2=B,s3=A achieves low f2. Exploring variations of s1=A and s1=D with combinations like s4=A or s4=E tests trade-offs between low f1 and low f2.
Combine low f1 from s1=A, s2=A, s3=B with intermediate f2 benefits from s4=C/B to explore the sharp trade-off between f1 and f2.
Evaluating s1=D with s4=D to test the f2 minimum, and testing variations of low-f1 configurations (s2=A, s3=B, s5=B, s6=B) with s4=D and other s1 values.
Testing s1=D with s2=A,s3=A across promising s4 values (C, B) to uncover low f2/moderate f1 tradeoffs, and probing s1=C/s1=B baselines with s2=B,s3=A.
Configurations with s1=A,s2=A,s3=B,s5=B,s6=B achieve extremely low f1 (~4.7k), while s4=D (ignoring s5/s6) is unexplored there. Also, testing s1=C,D with s4=C,D targets low f2 tradeoffs.
Test s4=C with s1=B and s2=B, s3=A to balance f1/f2 trade-off around f2~2300, and explore s1=B, s2=A, s3=A with s4=C to improve f1 in the mid-range.
Exploration begins by testing alternative primary labels for s1 and s4 while perturbing binary toggles s2, s3, s5, and s6 to discover gradient signals across both objectives.
s1=A showed strongly reduced f1, while s4=D preserves low f2. Testing s1=A with varying s2/s3 and s4=A or s4=D may yield better trade-offs near the low-f1 edge.
s1=E achieves the best f1 when combined with s2=A, s3=B. Testing variations of s2/s3 under s1=E and exploring whether s4 affects lower-cost combinations without degrading f2 drastically.
s1=B with s4=E gave low f1 and modest f2. Testing other s4 variants with s1=B (such as s4=B or s4=C) may hit lower f1 while keeping f2 well below 20000.
Combining s1=B with s4=E and varying s5/s6 shows strong potential for intermediate Pareto improvements. Testing s1=B with s4=E, s5=A, s6=B explores lower f1 with competitive f2.
Combine low f1 from s4=B/C/D with s5=B, s6=A under s1=B, which previously achieved the global lowest f1 (78161) when s4=E. Also test s4=C with s5=B, s6=B.
Investigate s4=D/E combinations with s2=B, s3=B or test s1=C/D on s5=B, s6=A/B to balance lower f1 with low f2.
Combine top low-f1 features (s1=B, s5=B, s6=A or s5=B, s6=B) with unexplored s4 settings or investigate whether s1=B with s4=A can push f1/f2 boundaries further.
Initial exploration across primary sites s1 and s4 to assess their main effects relative to the baseline.
Test remaining unobserved labels for s1 (E) and s4 (D, E), while exploring combining low-f1 setting s1=C with lower-f2 setting s4=C to investigate trade-offs across dimensions.
Test untested sites s2, s3, s5, and s6 under high-performing s1 and s4 options (A, B, D) to uncover favorable interactions and further reduce f1/f2.
Combine strong f1-reducing labels (s1=B/A, s2=A) with s4=C or s4=D to exploit synergies between s1/s2 improvements and low-f2 variants of s4, plus test s6=A.
Testing s4=A and s4=E with the high-performing s1=B, s2=A combination to push the low-f1 frontier, alongside checking s1=A with s4=D.
Combining s1=C (or s2=A) with other variations like s4=A or testing s3=B combinations to find lower f1 or balanced trade-offs. Also explore s1=C with s4=E and s4=A.
Combine high-performing s5=B with s1=B, s2=A, s4=D across variations of s3 and s6, as s5=B yielded dramatic f1 improvements with negligible f2 penalty in run 31.
Combine strong low-cost configurations: test s1=C with s4=D/B and variations on s5/s6 to discover non-dominated trade-offs between f1=40k-110k and f2=6k-9k, or explore s1=B, s2=B with s5=B.
Explore major alternative values for top-level sites s1 and s4 to identify strong main effects on f1 and f2 compared to baseline.
Exploration of untested labels for s2, s3, s5, and s6 under high-performing s1 and s4 backbones (such as s1=B, s1=C, and s4=E) to map interactions.
Investigate the strong f1 reduction seen from s2=B/s3=A isolated from s5/s6 changes, and test s1=E with low-cost s4 variants to refine the trade-off front.
Evaluating effects of s5=A and s6=A which drastically reduced f1 in config 8, paired with different s1 and s4 options to explore the low-f1, high-f2 trade-off region.
Explores combinations with low f1 (s2=B, s3=A, s5=A, s6=A) across untested s1/s4 values (like s1=D), and tests individual contributions of s5=A and s6=A to optimize intermediate trade-offs.
Combine low f1 labels (s1=E/D, s2=B, s3=A, s5=A, s6=A) with s4 variations (D, A, C) which previously lowered f1, targeting improvements on the extreme low-f1 boundary.
Testing s1=C and s1=D combinations with s4=C/A/D and s5/s6 variations to discover non-dominated trade-offs in the mid-f1 range and push the extreme low-f1 frontier.
Test s4=D on Pareto solutions with balanced trade-offs (e.g. s1=A, s2=B, s3=A or s2=B, s3=B), and test s1=B at the low-f1 corner.
Test alternative primary settings for s1 and s4 to identify strong main effects away from baseline E and C.
Config 6 achieved very low f1 with s1=A, s2=B, s3=B, s4=C. We explore nearby configurations varying s5 and s6 to check if f2 can be improved while preserving the strong f1 performance.
s1=D provides low f2 while s5/s6=B drastically reduces f1 (as seen in config 6 vs 7). Combining s1=D with s5=B, s6=B, and testing s4 options aims to dominate the mid-tradeoff region.
Combine low f1 settings (s1=A, s2=B, s3=B, s5=B, s6=B) with s4=E, which lowered f1 over s4=C in evaluations 9 and 13. Also explore intermediate f2 settings using s5=B, s6=A.
Testing s1=A with s2=A and s3=B or variants to explore low f2 with reduced f1, as well as pairing s1=E with low f1 combinations from s4=E.
Test s4=D on high-performing baselines (s1=A, s2=B, s3=B/A, s5=B, s6=B) and s1=D with s5=B,s6=A where f2 is low.
Test s4=A and s4=B combinations with high-performing s2/s3/s5/s6 baselines to find lower f2 with moderate f1, exploring unvisited configurations on the Pareto-optimal frontier.
Combine top-performing labels (s1=A, s3=B) with low-f2 settings (s5=A, s6=A or s5=B, s6=A) to discover intermediate Pareto points between f2=3000 and 10000.
Initial exploration across primary sites s1 and s4 to identify strong main effects on f1 and f2 compared to baseline.
s1=E drastically reduced f1 to 2% at high f2. Evaluating s1=E across different s4 choices (like A, C) and testing other s2/s3 variants with s1=D/B to map intermediate Pareto regions.
Config 6 reached f1=5001 with high f2; testing s2=A and s3=A across promising s1 settings (D and B) and isolating s3=A to map the extreme low-f1 trade-off boundary.
Config 6 reached f1=5001 using s4=B, s5=B, s6=B. Testing whether other s1 choices (D, B, C) or s2/s3 combinations with s4=B/E achieve even better Pareto trade-offs or ultra-low f1.
s4=B combined with s2=A, s3=A yields extremely low f1 (~5k) with high f2 (~20k). Testing s1=A,C,D under s4=B with varied s5,s6 explores dominating configurations in the ultra-low f1 regime.
Combine top low-f1 branches (s1=E/C, s2=A, s3=A, s4=B) with variations in s5/s6, and test intermediate trade-offs with s1=D and s4=D/E to push non-dominated solutions across f1 and f2.
Test s4=D/E with s1=B or s1=A to lower f1 while keeping f2 low, and test s1=D with s5/s6 variations under s4=B to improve trade-offs between 78k and 147k.
Evaluating configurations that pair s1=D and s1=C with various s4 labels and s5/s6 settings, targeting under-explored regions with low f1 and balanced f2 along the Pareto frontier.
Explore alternative primary settings for s1 and s4 while testing both conditioned and default choices on downstream sites.
s1=D and s4=C achieved strong f1 reduction. Testing s1=D with lower-cost s4 choices (A, B) and isolating s2/s3/s5/s6 parameters to find lower f2 with preserved f1 gains.
Combine strong f1 reduction from s1=D, s2=B with low-f2 variants s4=B and s4=C, and test s3/s5/s6 variations to push the Pareto frontier.
Combine strong f1-reducing choices (s1=D, s2=B, s3=B) with s4 variations (B, C, D) and s5=B, aiming to push the low-f1 Pareto boundary beyond run 15.
Testing s5=B and s6=B variations across promising s1=D configurations to drive f1 down while monitoring impacts on f2.
Combine the ultra-low f1 features (s5=B, s6=B) with intermediate s2/s3 settings or lower-f2 branches (like s3=A, s2=A) to find dominating or balanced Pareto points across the entire frontier.
Explores combinations around s5=B, s6=B with s4=B and s4=D which often slightly improve f1 over s4=C, and tests s1=B with s5/s6 variations to push the low f2 region.
Evaluating s1=B with s4=C and s4=D to potentially dominate existing low-f2 solutions, and testing s4=E combinations with s2=B, s3=B to find even lower f1 values.
Initial exploration across the primary unconditioned branching parameters s1 and s4 to identify strong main effects on f1 and f2 relative to the baseline.
s1=C strongly minimizes f1 while s4=B minimizes f2. Testing combinations of s1 and s4 with unexplored settings (s1=E, s4=E) and mixing s1=C with s4 variants should expand the Pareto frontier.
Test unexplored settings of s2, s3, s5, and s6 on promising s1/s4 backbones (s1=A, s1=C, s4=A, s4=B) to uncover orthogonal trade-off improvements.
Combine strong f1-reducing choices (s1=A, s2=B) with s4=A and explore s4=C/E with s2=B or s6=B to discover lower f1 values along the Pareto frontier.
Combine strong f1-reducing labels (s1=A, s2=B, s4=A/C) with downstream variants at s5 and s6 to explore further f1 improvements against moderate f2 trade-offs.
Combining s5=B (which strongly reduces f1) with promising combinations on s1=C, s1=D, and exploring s2=B with s3=B or other s4 variants to find non-dominated points in the low-f1, moderate-f2 regime.
Combining s1=C (or D/E) with s5=B, or testing s1=E/D with s2=B, targets the lower-left Pareto frontier where f1 is heavily reduced without excessive f2 penalties.
Testing s1=E with s2=B and s5=B across s4=D,E and exploring s1=E with s4=A,B to potentially find non-dominated solutions matching the lowest f1 values.
